dog.description_text:
You’ll flip for Pancake, the sweetest 3-year-old, 46-pound Retriever-mix who stacks cuteness, friendliness and good behavior perfectly! Pancake is an impossibly well-behaved pup who has yet to find a person she doesn’t want to befriend. She is incredibly social, greeting almost everybody, while being extremely calm and gentle. She is known to very politely ask for belly rubs and will absolutely melt if you oblige. She is dedicated to becoming a lap dog and always wants to be by your side. Pancake is also great with other dogs, remaining calm and friendly when encountering fellow canines on and off leash. She enjoys long walks and car rides and is happy in any situation so long as she gets to be with her people. She is also fully crate and leash trained and responds well to commands and corrections. She is an absolute angel and makes friends so easily. Pancake is the perfect touch of sweetness to start your day and she just can’t wait to meet you!

Approved adopters interested in Pancake can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not approved yet, apply today at hbrdogs.com.
